heading: Insurers, TPAs and corporates
description: The organisations this hospital bills instead of the patient: insurers, third-party administrators and corporates, with their plans and rate agreements.
add: Add an insurer, TPA or corporate
empty: No insurers, TPAs or corporates yet.

create.heading: Add an insurer, TPA or corporate
create.description: The code is the hospital's own short name for it and cannot be changed later.

form.codeHint: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Unique among your organisations.
form.name: Name
form.contactHint: Someone at the organisation, not a patient.

notFound.title: Organisation not found
notFound.body: There is no such insurer, TPA or corporate at this hospital.

plans.heading: Plans
plans.description: What each plan covers, how much of a covered charge the patient pays, its limits and who is eligible.
plans.name: Plan

plan.description: Amounts are in the hospital's currency. Leave a limit empty for no limit.
plan.codeHint: Unique among this organisation's plans. It cannot be changed later.
plan.name: Name
plan.copayHint: The part of a covered charge the patient pays, 0 to 100.
plan.preAuthHint: Admissions and procedures under this plan wait for the payer's approval.
plan.waitingHint: Days after the policy starts before it pays.
plan.coverageHint: Choose whether the list below is what is left out or all that is covered.

errors.ageOrder: The oldest age cannot be below the youngest.
errors.servicesNeeded: Add at least one service, or choose to cover everything except the list.

agreements.heading: Rate agreements
agreements.description: Prices agreed with this organisation for a period. An agreement is never edited: to change a price, end it and add a new one from a later date.
agreements.name: Agreement

agreement.description: Between the two dates, the discount applies to list prices, and an agreed rate replaces the list price of its service.
agreement.name: Name
agreement.noRates: No agreed rates: only the discount applies.

errors.endBeforeStart: The last day cannot be before the first.

errors.duplicate_code: That code is already used. Choose another.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this just now. What you typed is kept; check it and save again.
errors.agreement_overlap: This period overlaps another agreement with the same organisation. End that one first or choose other dates.
errors.starts_in_past: An agreement cannot start in the past.
errors.payer_archived: This organisation is archived. Restore it first.
errors.service_not_found: A service in the list no longer exists. Remove it and try again.
errors.duplicate_policy: This policy is already on the patient’s record.
errors.policy_not_active: This policy is no longer active. Choose another policy.
errors.not_submitted: This request has already been answered or withdrawn.
errors.plan_archived: This plan is archived. Choose another plan.
errors.invalid_transition: The claim has moved on since you opened it. Reload it and try again.
errors.claim_exists: This visit already has a claim.
errors.nothing_to_claim: The payer owes nothing on this visit, so there is nothing to claim.
errors.credit_bill_exists: This visit is already billed to credit.
errors.nothing_to_bill: The visit has no charges to bill.
errors.credit_limit_exceeded: This is more than the credit left on the account. Raise the limit or take a receipt first.
errors.below_outstanding: The limit cannot be below what the corporate already owes.
errors.exceeds_outstanding: This is more than the corporate owes.
errors.not_corporate: Only a corporate can have a credit account.

policy.heading: Policies
policy.empty: No insurance policy on this record.

add.title: Add an insurance policy
add.description: The organisation and plan, the number on the card and the dates it runs.

policy.validToHint: Leave empty when the policy has no end date.

end.title: End this policy?
end.description: It can no longer back a new pre-authorization. Requests already made are kept as they were.

errors.endBeforeStart: The last day is before the first.

preauth.heading: Pre-authorizations
preauth.empty: No pre-authorization requested for this patient.
preauth.needsPolicy: Add an active policy before asking a payer for approval.
preauth.treatmentHint: What the payer is asked to approve.
preauth.documentsHint: One name to a line. The files themselves are kept on the patient’s record, under Documents.
preauth.approvedHint: The limit the payer agreed to cover.

add.title: Request pre-authorization
add.description: Asks the payer of one of the patient’s active policies to approve the cost.

cancel.title: Withdraw this request?
cancel.description: The payer is no longer asked to approve it. This cannot be undone.

limit.heading: Insurance cover for this visit
limit.waiting: Waiting for the payer to answer a request for {{amount}}.
limit.refused: The payer did not approve this request.

warning.near: The bill is near the approved limit. Ask the payer for more before it passes.
warning.reached: The bill has reached the approved limit. The patient pays what is above it.

split.heading: Split between the patient and the payer
split.terms: {{payer}}, {{plan}}: the patient pays {{percent}}% of what is covered.

reason.service_limit: Above the limit for this service

split.empty: There are no charges to split yet.
split.reconciled: The split adds up to the charges
split.notReconciled: The split does not add up to the charges
split.stale: The charges have changed since the split was saved. Save it again before billing from it.

claims.heading: Insurance claims
claims.description: Claims sent to insurers and TPAs for the payer share of a visit: what is waiting, what was paid and what was given up.
claims.empty: No claims yet. Prepare one from a visit’s bill.

detail.heading: Claim {{number}}
detail.packetHint: The files are on the patient’s record, under Documents.
detail.noActions: Nothing more can be done to this claim.
detail.noRights: You can read this claim but not change it.

description.submit: Marks the claim as sent. The days to payment count from now.
description.raise_query: Writes down what the payer asked for.
description.reply: Answers the payer’s question and sends the claim back to the payer.
description.approve: Writes down what the payer agreed to pay.
description.reject: Writes down that the payer refused the claim.
description.settle: Writes down a payment that came in.
description.write_off: Gives up what the payer will not pay. This cannot be undone and is kept on the record.
description.cancel: Takes the claim back. This cannot be undone.

dialog.approvedHint: Up to the amount claimed, in the hospital’s currency.
dialog.receivedHint: Up to the amount approved, in the hospital’s currency.
dialog.documentsHint: One name to a line. The files are on the patient’s record.

packet.title: Prepare a claim
packet.description: Makes a claim for the payer’s share of this visit, {{amount}}, as split above. Name what is enclosed.
packet.documentsHint: One name to a line, such as the discharge summary and the final bill. The files are on the patient’s record, under Documents.

agingPage.heading: Aging of unpaid claims
agingPage.description: What the payers still owe, by the days since each claim was sent. Claims not yet sent are not counted.
agingPage.gridLabel: Unpaid claims by payer and age
agingPage.empty: Nothing is owed on any claim.

errors.overClaimed: This is more than was claimed.
errors.overApproved: This is more than was approved.

credit.heading: Corporate credit
credit.description: Corporates billed on credit: what each has been billed, what it has paid and what is still owed.
credit.empty: No corporate has a credit account yet. Open one from the corporate’s page.

detail.heading: Credit account: {{name}}
detail.description: Bills put on this corporate, the money received against them and the statement.
detail.notFoundBody: The address is not a corporate of this hospital.
detail.noAccountBody: This corporate has no credit account yet. Open one with a credit limit and the days it has to pay.

terms.description: The most the corporate may owe at one time, and the days it has to pay a bill.
terms.limitHint: In the hospital’s currency, for example 50000.00.
terms.daysHint: A bill is due this many days after it is made. 0 to 365.

summary.heading: Where the account stands
summary.notReconciled: The figures of this account do not add up. Tell the system administrator.

receipts.heading: Receipts
receipts.empty: No money has been received on this account yet.

receipt.title: Record a receipt
receipt.description: {{name}} owes {{amount}}. The money is set against the oldest unpaid bills first.
receipt.amountHint: In the hospital’s currency. No more than is owed.
receipt.referenceHint: Transfer number or cheque number, if there is one.
receipt.doneDescription: {{amount}} was received and set against these bills.
receipt.reconciled: The receipt is fully set against bills
receipt.notReconciled: The receipt does not match the bills it was set against

statement.heading: Statement
statement.badPeriod: The first day must not be after the last day.
statement.empty: Nothing was billed or received in this period.
statement.reconciled: The statement agrees with the account
statement.notReconciled: The statement does not agree with the account. Tell the system administrator.

print.notReconciled: The amounts above do not add up to the receipt.

panel.heading: Bill to a corporate on credit
panel.description: Puts the whole visit on a corporate’s credit account, to be paid by its due date, instead of billing the patient.
panel.saved: Credit bill {{number}} for {{amount}} was put on {{name}}, due {{due}}.

errors.overOwed: This is more than the corporate owes.
errors.futureDate: The date cannot be in the future.
